messages:
Anya: Noticed prefixes left in memory after node restarts. handback logs show success but residency stays >0.
Vik: Reproduced on canary. Restart -> churn -> prefix_count rises and never drops.
Morgan: My guess: epoch persisted differently than residency table so restarts can regress epoch and later ACKs are ignored.
Anya: Current code: if ack.epoch != local.epoch then ignore. That seems brittle on restarts.
Vik: Short-term fix ideas: on startup run a reconciliation pass that queries live lease owners for any prefix with count>0 and clear mismatches. Also emit metric reconcile.cleared_count.
Morgan: Add handshake_id per handoff so acks can be correlated even when epoch drifts slightly. If handshake_id matches, accept the ack regardless of minor epoch mismatch.
Anya: Ops: add alert if node.prefix_residency_delta > 10% sustained 20m. Also add debug endpoint /debug/prefix-residency that returns prefix->(count,last_handshake,owner,epoch) for debug-only use.
Vik: Long term: persist epoch with lease metadata in raft/log so restarts don't regress. Also change ack handling to reconciling mode when epoch < expected rather than outright ignoring.
Morgan: I'll put a 1% ACK-drop failpoint in staging and run a restart churn job to validate reconciliation.
InfraBot: infra: restarted node-22 at 2026-03-23T12:02:01Z for canary run.
Anya: I'll collect heap dumps + residency snapshots and attach after the run. If reconcile pass clears pins in staging we get immediate mitigation path.
Vik: Agree. After patches: add metrics handback.ignored_epoch, handback.accepted_by_handshake and a followup run.
Morgan: Will send a brief note to #postmortems template if we hit a leak in prod. Ping me to join debugging session.
Anya: Thanks all, we'll update in this thread.
